messages:
Maya (PM): Heads-up — need a final decision on onboarding safeguards for the Starter tier. Several pilots asking for large free credits + short-term SLA. Do we default to a generous trial or keep it contract-only?
Sam (Sales): Customer A pushed for 50k tokens + 30-day trial. They said it's blocker to sign.
Priya (Finance): 50k unrestricted tokens is a big revenue leak if we don’t gate it. We need quota shaping or expiry.
Jonah (Eng): Also FYI, burst capacity for pilots can blow out autoscaler costs if we don’t limit sustained throughput.
Lili (Legal): High SLAs need a written addendum. We can offer a time-limited SLA for pilots but it must be a signed attachment.
Erin (Solutions): What if we do a staged onboarding package: moderate free credits + temporary soft SLA + telemetry checks? Sales can escalate exceptions.
Maya (PM): Proposal draft: default trial = 20k tokens, valid 14 days; softcap burst = 2x baseline for 48h; higher trials (>=50k) require Sales + Legal approval.
billing-bot: Note: applying free credit rule will require a new ledger flag (trial_grant).
Priya (Finance): 20k/14d seems fine if we implement automatic expiration and per-account throttling. Also suggest burn-rate limits (tokens/day).
Sam (Sales): Can we offer a one-time promo code for 50k when AE+AM approve? That keeps control but helps close deals.
Lili (Legal): Promo code + signed LOA works. No SLA baked in unless addendum attached.
Jonah (Eng): For telemetry: we can mark trial accounts and apply a rolling 24h token cap. If cap hit, system returns 429 with info on upgrade path. Minimal infra work.
Erin (Solutions): Also recommend a pilot clause template: length, observable success metrics, rollback path, and a single point of contact. Makes internal handoffs smoother.
Maya (PM): Ok decision candidate: default = 20k tokens/14d + 24h rolling cap + 2x short burst for 48h; exceptions via promo code + signed LOA that Sales requests. Addendum required for any SLA.
Priya (Finance): Please add accounting rules: tag promo credits as 'sales_promos' to avoid miscounting usage revenue.
Sam (Sales): Good enough to move forward. I'll note the promo workflow for AEs. :thumbsup:
Lili (Legal): I'll draft a short LOA template and attach SLA language for enterprise.
Jonah (Eng): I'll open a small infra task for trial flags + 24h cap + 429 message text.
Maya (PM): I'll create the spec and add A/B tracking to measure conversion lift. We can revisit after 6 weeks.
Erin (Solutions): Echoing — include a short FAQ for CSMs.
Maya (PM): Thanks everyone. Locking plan unless any blocking objections by EOD. :lock:
